FIRST ADDENDUM 
 to Agreement to Sell by and between 
 V4 Capital (referred to as “Developer” ) and Huma Javaid w/o Muhammad Javaid (referred to as “Buyer " ) 
 [Each a “ Party ” and, collectively, “ Parties ”] 
 This first a ddendum (“ First A ddendum ”) to Agreement to Sell dated [•] 2020 , (“ Agreement to Sell ”) is made and entered into at Lahore on this [•], 202 3 (“ Effective Date ”). 
 WHEREAS 
 The Developer is developing and constructing residential houses located at Phase III, Sector A and Sector B, Defence Housing Authority, Islamabad-Rawalpindi. 
 The Parties entered into the Agreement to Sell bearing No. RA/099 , dated ____________ for the sale and purchase of constructed residential house along with the fixtures and fittings located at Unit No. 9, Street No. 22 , with total area 133 Sq . Yards located at Phase III, Sector A and Sector B, Defence Housing Authority Islamabad-Rawalpindi (“ Unit ”) ; 
 The Developer was under obligation to construct a residential house on the land a s part and parcel of the Agreement to Sell and handover the Unit to the Buyer . However, the Parties have now mutually agreed to transfer Plot No. 9, Street No. 22, with total area 133 Sq. Yards located at Phase III, Sector A and Sector B, Defence Housing Authority Islamabad-Rawalpindi along with the the partially constructed structure on it ( “Plot” ) for the Purchase Price (defined below) Unit . 
 P ursuant to Clause 1 4 . 2 of the Agreement , the Parties hereby mutual ly agree to revise , amend and supplement the Agreement in accordance with the terms and conditions hereof. 
 
 NOW , THEREFORE, the P arties agree as follows: 
 The First A ddendum shall be effective from the Effective Date . 
 T he Seller s shall sell its rights , title and interest in the Plot to the Buyer for a total consideration of PKR 10,000,000 (Rupees ten million) (“ Purchase Price ”) in accordance with the terms and conditions stated herein . 
 The Developer acknowledges that the Buyer has paid and the Developer has received the total Purchase Price against the Plot Pak Rupees T en (10) Million on account of full and final payment toward s the Purchase Price of the partially constructed Unit and nothing on account of Purchase Price outstands against the Buyer . 
 For the Purchase Price provided above the Developer has agreed to sell and transfer rights, title and interest in the plot and the partially constructed Unit to the Buyer in accordance with the terms and conditions stated herein. 
 The Buyer acknowledges and undertakes to complete the construction of residential house on the Plot as per the rules and reg ulations of Defence Housing Authority Islamabad-Rawalpindi . 
 The Buyer hereby has agreed to discharge s and releases the Developer , its employees, agents, sub-contractors, successors and assigns from any and all claims, demands, obligations, liabilities, or causes of action, whether known or unknown, arising out of or relating to the P lot of all obligations including all the construction of residential house along with fixtures and fittings and financial obligations under as per the Agreement to Sell bearing No. RA/099, as of dated _________ ( “Agreement to Sell” ) [Insert Date] and the Developer has acknowledged the discharge of these all the obligation s and has agreed to transfer the partially constructed Unit along with the plot in lieu of the same . 
 In the event of any conflict, the provisions of the First Addendum shall prevail, and any conflicting term in the Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately. 
 This First A ddendum shall be read as an integral part of the Agreement to Sell . 
 Any conflicting terms in the Agreement to Sell shall be deemed amended appropriately to give effect to the intention of the Parties herein. 
 All other terms and provisions in the Agreement to Sell shall apply mutatis mutandis , and shall continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event of any conflict bet ween the provisions of Agreement to Sell and this First Addendum , the provisions of this First Addendum shall prevail. 
 All expressions and terms defined or used in the Agreement to Sell shall bear the same meaning in this First A ddendum , unless otherwise specified. 
 The First A ddendum may be entered into in counterparts, all of which taken together shall constitute one and the same addendum . 
 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this First Addendum , having fully understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will, in the presence of witnesses .
